training.split: First14 complete pairs per family train, last6 calibrate, matching frozen prior study.
training.deduplication: One initial army per pair and color; swapped games never duplicate setup training.
training.recipe: 40 fixed EM iterations; initial weights0.5, row priors0.25, theta[-1,2]. Add-one style and Flag-row counts. Theta grids[-4,0] and[0,4] step0.25; quadratic log penalty0.5*theta^2. No calibration fitting.
training.feature: Initial Flag row and orthogonal Flag-Bomb adjacency only; no family labels, outcomes or move labels used.
training.limitations: Mixture is a simplified setup distribution, not an opponent action model. Mobile ranks exchangeable except original public behavior factors.

research.connection: Section2.2 motivates protected Flags, decoys and exposed Flags; this exact mixture/subset model is our hypothesis, not the paper algorithm.
